title: Hazardous-drug compounding overlay
rule_summary: When a Massachusetts pharmacy compounds a hazardous drug, it must satisfy the applicable sterile or non-sterile compounding framework and also the current hazardous-drug handling standards made applicable through 247 CMR 9.01 and current USP <800>. Hazard classification does not replace the underlying sterile/non-sterile compounding requirements, and sterile/non-sterile compliance does not erase hazardous-drug controls.
exam_relevance: Tests the simultaneous application of compounding and hazardous-drug frameworks.
common_confusions: Hazardous-drug status is an overlay, not a replacement for sterile or non-sterile compounding requirements.
verification_notes: Current official Massachusetts authority verified during Pre-Batch3 T2 authoring on 2026-08-18; fresh independent legal and realism audit is still required before release.
